summary.text: Amy Kuhn is a Democratic state representative from Falmouth, Maine, who has represented District 111 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kuhn lives in Falmouth, Maine, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Kuhn took office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, succeeding John Ducharme.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignment for 2023-2024 as the Judiciary Committee and for 2025-2026 as the Ethics Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, in which she was the only candidate.
